summary: The url lookup returns _list, a list containing either lists of lines or the raw content of each URL.
questions: What does the url lookup return?
Why does the url lookup give me a list rather than a string?

answer_card.title: url lookup return value
answer_card.answer_md: Returns `_list`: a list of lists of lines (default) or the whole content of each URL when `split_lines=False`.
